name: Implement distribution-based testing for nameforma
summary: Configure the test suite for @sc-voice/nameforma to run against its compiled distribution (dist/) rather than source code to validate exports and build artifacts.

rawActions.name: Audit Module Resolution
rawActions.summary: package.json: main only, no exports field, no types field. tsconfig.json: declaration=true, outDir=dist (dist/index.d.ts emitted after build). tsconfig.test.json: no paths alias for @sc-voice/nameforma. vitest.config.mjs: no resolve.alias. Tests: mix of ../src/ relative imports and one @sc-voice/nameforma import in test/forma-list.ts:3.
rawActions.statusNote: audit complete, findings recorded in summary

rawActions.name: Configure Distribution-First Testing
rawActions.summary: Four changes needed: (1) package.json: add types field (./dist/index.d.ts) and exports field with both . and ./internal subpaths. (2) tsconfig.test.json: add paths aliases for @sc-voice/nameforma (./dist/index.d.ts) and @sc-voice/nameforma/internal (./dist/internal.d.ts). (3) Migrate test imports — replace ../src/ relative imports with named imports from @sc-voice/nameforma or @sc-voice/nameforma/internal; XNameForma is deprecated so tests using NameForma destructuring switch to direct named imports. Files: test/forma-list.ts, test/world.ts, test/task.ts, test/focus-manager.ts, test/cli/cli-task.ts, test/cli/tui-list.ts. (4) helpers.ts imports also from ../src/ — check and migrate if needed.
rawActions.statusNote: all 42 test files pass; package.json exports/types set; tsconfig.test.json paths configured; all test imports migrated to @sc-voice/nameforma and @sc-voice/nameforma/internal

rawActions.name: Validation
rawActions.summary: Verify build artifacts existence and confirm test suite passes using package name resolution.

rawActions.name: Update src/index.ts Exports
rawActions.summary: src/index.ts currently only exports the NameForma aggregate object and type-only exports. Two gaps block distribution-based testing: (1) Individual named value exports are missing — import { Forma, World } from @sc-voice/nameforma returns undefined at runtime. Add export { Action, Forma, FormaList, Task, User, UUID64, RGA64Node, Schema, Rational, Reference, ... } plus new additions: World (./world.js), Entity (./entity.js), FuzzyNamespace (./fuzzy-namespace.js), FocusManager (./focus-manager.js). (2) CLI internals decision — TaskCommand, NfCLI, nfTui, CliRenderer, TuiList are not in the public API. Decision: route CLI test files to ../../dist/cli/ paths rather than exporting internals from index.ts.
rawActions.statusNote: build clean; 697 tests pass; forma-list.ts @sc-voice/nameforma resolution blocked on QXX00 exports config
